budget_items.topic: Town Manager pay increase after performance review
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager was awarded a 3% pay increase following the Executive Session review.
budget_items.quote: as a result, ms. lemieux has been awarded a 3% pay increase.

budget_items.topic: Total receivables on the books (mostly sewer betterments)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The auditor reported a large receivable on the books in excess of $6.8 million, mostly sewer betterments.
budget_items.quote: the town has a large receivable on the books in excess of $6.8 million; the majority of that relates to sewer betterments.

budget_items.topic: MSBA receivables for the Primary School
budget_items.what_was_recorded: There is $3.7 million in receivables from the MSBA, of which $2.6 million was for the Primary School.
budget_items.quote: there is $3.7 million worth of receivables from the massachusetts school building authority (msba); $2.6 million of that was for the primary school.

budget_items.topic: MSBA fixed-fee reimbursement on Primary School bond
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Primary School project was reimbursed under an old fixed-fee method at around $4/0,000 per year, fully paid off in 2023.
budget_items.quote: reimburse a fixed fee for the life of the bond; around $4/0,000 per year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town had a $1.1 million receivable on the $73 million Middle/High School project, reimbursed at 59% by the MSBA.
budget_items.quote: the town also had a receivable for $1.1 million on the middle/high school project. that is a $73 million project being reimbursed at 59% by the msba.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The tax liens and foreclosures balance has grown by $360,000 since 2014 and now stands at $1.2 million, representing uncollected free cash.
budget_items.quote: that balance has increased by $360,000 since 2014

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town has a 98% success rate collecting real estate taxes.
budget_items.quote: he did note the town had a 98% success rate of collecting real estate taxes.

budget_items.topic: Revenue collected and expenditures through December 31, 2017
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town had collected 50.86% of estimated revenues and expended 49.4% of budgeted expenditures through December 31, 2017.
budget_items.quote: we have collected 50.86% of estimated revenues through december 31, 2017. we have expended 49.4% of budgeted expenditures

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Departmental Revenue-Schools, Fees, Fines & Forfeits, and Penalties and Interest collections were running above estimate.
budget_items.quote: one is departmental revenue -schools (93.77%), fees (60.11%), fines & forfeits (72.95%), and penalties and interest (70.95%).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Clerk is the only department head expected to go over budget, due to increased elections in 2018.
budget_items.quote: the only department head who has expressed her budget will go over is the town clerk due to increased elections in 2018.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant, a payroll warrant, a payroll deductions warrant and a school warrant.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $179,416.05; a payroll warrant in the amount of $740,748.41, a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $164,198.14 and a school warrant in the amount of $1331.20.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MART changed the dispatching reimbursement back to 33% of direct costs to operate the van, with dispatcher scheduling time now counted as a direct cost.
budget_items.quote: mart has changed the reimbursement model for dispatching back to 33%
